clue.text: He travels up from Belgravia to Richmond

indicators.note: the letters are taken out from the run of words Belgravia to Richmond, sitting across the word breaks

explanation.surface: Someone makes a journey from the smart London district of Belgravia out to Richmond.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' belongs with the definition, a flyer travels up, not a reversal signal, since this is an across clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilot is a person whose journeys take them up into the sky.

clue.text: Position in role of acting new associate

parts.note: as means in the role of

explanation.surface: An actor takes a role as a new associate.
explanation.definitionFit: In yoga, a posture or pose held by the body is called this.

clue.text: With 17 going off and child's cot seen inside, cutter is required

indicators.note: the cot is placed inside the jumbled letters
going off suggests something exploding, so the letters scatter

parts.note: the answer to 17 across is a word for an attractive lady
a crib is a child's cot

explanation.surface: An alarm going off while a child's cot is seen indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going off' gives INSER, the jumbled letters of 17's answer, and 'seen inside' splits it so the cot sits within.
explanation.definitionFit: An engraver cuts letters into stone or metal.

clue.text: Contraceptive help it might provide to student

indicators.note: the letters of help it could provide a new arrangement

parts.note: L is for learner, a student

explanation.surface: A health centre might give contraceptive help to a student.
explanation.definitionFit: The oral contraceptive is known familiarly by this name.

clue.text: A rose mostly needs ground — in a way it's best practice

definitions.text: in a way it's best practice

indicators.note: ground means crushed or milled, so the letters are mixed up
mostly means the word loses its last letter

explanation.surface: A gardener's advice that roses need ground soil as best practice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops E from 'rose'; way means road.
explanation.definitionFit: Awareness of traffic and safe behaviour on the street is the best practice on the road.

clue.text: Beside yourself there's a note in old currency

indicators.note: the note is placed inside the word for the old currency

parts.note: the franc was the French currency before the euro
ti is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale (also te)

explanation.surface: Someone is distraught to find an old banknote that is no longer legal tender.
explanation.definitionFit: Being beside yourself is an idiom for being wildly agitated or distraught.

clue.text: Goes without butter etc around start of Shrovetide?

indicators.note: the fats word wraps around the letter

parts.note: butter and similar are fats

indicators.note: the start is the first letter of Shrovetide

explanation.surface: Butter around Shrove Tuesday, pancake day, before Lent's fasting.
explanation.definitionFit: Going without food, as in Lent, is to abstain from eating.

clue.text: Keep off tar splotch

parts.note: a tar is a sailor, AB being able seaman
a stain is a splotch

explanation.surface: A warning to keep away from a splash of tar.
explanation.definitionFit: To refrain from something is to hold back, a synonym for keep off.

clue.text: Am I to leave Tia Maria? It might go to one's head

definitions.text: It might go to one's head

indicators.note: the three letters are taken out of the liqueur name, leaving the rest

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether to leave a coffee liqueur, which might go to one's head.
explanation.walkthrough: Tia Maria is a coffee liqueur.
explanation.definitionFit: A jewelled crown or headdress is worn on the head.

clue.text: Turn is rigged with dodgy caddy and fixed in advance

indicators.note: rigged means arranged differently, so the letters are rearranged
dodgy suggests the letters are unreliable and to be shuffled

explanation.surface: A golf result is rigged with a dodgy caddy.
explanation.definitionFit: Settled beforehand and not open to dispute, an idiomatic phrase.

clue.text: Is drink drunk in part of theatre?

indicators.note: something drunk is reeling about, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: ale is a type of beer

explanation.surface: A question about whether someone is drinking in the theatre.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatre has gangways between rows of seats, a passageway down the auditorium.

clue.text: Getting top off fruit drink, I'll leave nasty Mark to get help

indicators.note: removing the top takes away the first letter of the drink

parts.note: cassis is a blackcurrant liqueur

indicators.note: the letter I is said to leave, so it drops out of the word for a nasty mark

parts.note: a taint is a stain or blemish, a nasty mark

explanation.surface: Someone with a drink tells nasty Mark to get help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'top off' removes C from CASSIS, giving ASSIS; 'I'll leave' takes I out of TAINT, giving TANT.
explanation.definitionFit: An aide or helper is a person who gives help, so the noun matches.

clue.text: Near-disastrous events, as first I then bodyguard are captured by soldiers

indicators.note: both pieces end up held inside the word for soldiers
the letter I goes into the soldiers first, before the bodyguard does

parts.note: armies are bodies of soldiers
the SS began as Hitler's personal bodyguard unit

explanation.surface: A tale of military capture where a bodyguard is seized by troops.
explanation.walkthrough: 'first' and 'then' set the order: the lone letter goes in before the bodyguard, which began as Hitler's personal protection squad.
explanation.definitionFit: Near collisions between aircraft in flight are officially called this, near-disasters.

clue.text: Year's profit in another time

parts.note: a is short for annum, a year, as in per annum
a gain is a profit

explanation.surface: A business's annual profit has been made once more.
explanation.definitionFit: Once more, or on another occasion, is the adverb's ordinary sense.

clue.text: A medic, in the end you clean up mobile medical unit

parts.note: MB is Bachelor of Medicine, a doctor's qualification

indicators.note: the last letter of 'you' is taken
something messed up is disordered, so the letters of clean are rearranged

explanation.surface: A doctor is told that in the end they will have to clean up.
explanation.definitionFit: A vehicle equipped to carry patients to hospital is a medical unit on wheels.

clue.text: Out of energy, the moment placed in a cot was off

indicators.note: out of means the letter for energy is removed
placed in puts the moment inside the cot

parts.note: a cot is a bed
a second is a moment
E is the symbol for energy

explanation.surface: An exhausted parent puts a baby in a cot and leaves.
explanation.walkthrough: SECOND goes into A BED, giving ABSECONDED; 'Out of' removes an E.
explanation.definitionFit: To run off or flee secretly is to be off, gone.

clue.text: Look at cats at the far end — they're on the lids

indicators.note: the cats are placed at the far end, after the look

parts.note: to eye is to look at
cat-o'-nine-tails strokes are lashes

explanation.surface: Look at cats at the far end of a room.
explanation.definitionFit: Hairs growing on the edge of the eyelids.

clue.text: Migrant boy is sent back

indicators.note: sending back turns the boy's name round to read the other way

parts.note: Damon is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A young immigrant is deported.
explanation.definitionFit: A wanderer with no fixed home migrates from place to place.

clue.text: Bloke posed by area of Tyne, one in five being a model

parts.note: a bloke is a man
NE, the North East, is the region of England with the River Tyne
a quin is one of quintuplets

explanation.surface: A man posing by Tyneside, a fifth one being a model.
explanation.definitionFit: A dummy used to display clothes is a model figure.

clue.text: Attractive lady and gentleman when half cut

parts.note: sir is the form of address for a gentleman

indicators.note: the word when is cut in half and only its back half kept

explanation.surface: A lady and gentleman are attractive when tipsy, half cut being slang for drunk.
explanation.definitionFit: In myth the Sirens lured sailors with song, so any alluring woman is so called.

clue.text: Pays attention once it's funny

indicators.note: funny means strange, so the letters are odd and rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone pays attention once it's funny.
explanation.definitionFit: To observe or spot is to pay attention, a present-tense verb.

clue.text: It's not expected, dope and cocaine to be wrapped in coarse sort of paper

indicators.note: the two drug pieces go inside the paper word

parts.note: emery paper is a coarse abrasive paper
gen is slang for information, the dope
C is slang shorthand for cocaine

explanation.surface: Drugs wrapped in rough paper, an unexpected find in a police search.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' looks like a drug but means information, GEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A crisis is a sudden unforeseen situation, something nobody expected.

clue.text: God, at top only, has an elephant's head surprisingly

definitions.text: God, at top only, has an elephant's head surprisingly

indicators.note: only the top letter of God is used
surprisingly signals the letters arranged in a new order
head is the first letter of elephant

explanation.surface: A deity, astonishingly, sports an elephant's head.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes the Hindu god, famous for his elephant head.
explanation.definitionFit: The Hindu deity of wisdom and new beginnings is depicted with an elephant head.

clue.text: Regulator according to report is not working, eh?

indicators.note: the phrase signals that the words are heard spoken rather than spelt

parts.note: off means not working and what? is an exclamation like eh?

explanation.surface: A grumble that a regulator is failing at its job.
explanation.walkthrough: OFWAT is the UK water services regulator.
explanation.definitionFit: Ofwat is the official body overseeing the water industry in England and Wales.

clue.text: A denial second of requirements is promoted?

indicators.note: promoted moves the letter higher in this down entry

parts.note: wants are requirements

explanation.surface: Someone denies that the second item of requirements got promoted.
explanation.definitionFit: A contracted negative of was, used to deny something.

clue.text: Stupid barrel's dry

parts.note: b is an abbreviation for barrel
dry weather is without rain

explanation.surface: A dry barrel, perhaps an empty one, is called stupid.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests an empty head, like the barrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking a brain is a straightforward way of calling someone dim or foolish.

clue.text: Fill up with gas that's left on board ship

indicators.note: being on board is being inside the vessel

parts.note: a boat is a ship

explanation.surface: Fumes left on a ship fill the hold.
explanation.definitionFit: To swell up with gas, as in a bloated stomach.

clue.text: Pan maybe placed on lower parts of pantry floor

indicators.note: in a down clue on means above, so this piece comes first

parts.note: sat means placed

indicators.note: the bottom letters are the last letters of each word

explanation.surface: A cooking pan placed on the pantry floor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pan' is the Greek god, not a cooking pot.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god Pan was a goat-legged woodland spirit, an example of this creature.

clue.text: Maybe delicacy's required with idiot hospital cleaner

parts.note: a delicacy is perhaps a dish of food
a clot is a fool
H is the map abbreviation for hospital

explanation.surface: A fancy dish is served alongside a fool in hospital.
explanation.definitionFit: A cloth used for washing plates is an item for cleaning.

clue.text: Avoid road junction car crash

parts.note: to shun is to avoid
a T-junction is a road junction

explanation.surface: Steering clear of a junction to avoid a car crash.
explanation.definitionFit: A minor collision between vehicles is informally called this in British English.

clue.text: File a little bit back on tips of several elongated toenails

indicators.note: back means the word for a little bit, with a, is read backwards

parts.note: a tad is a little bit

indicators.note: the tips are the first letters of each word

explanation.surface: Filing back the tips of several overlong toenails a little.
explanation.walkthrough: 'File' looks like a nail file, but it is a computer file.
explanation.definitionFit: A collection of data held together on a computer is a kind of file.

clue.text: Tool I removed from basket under top of shelving

indicators.note: the basket word sits under the shelving letter, so comes after it
the top is the first letter of shelving
the letter I is taken out of the basket word

parts.note: a pannier is a basket carried on a bike or animal

explanation.surface: Someone takes a tool out of a basket kept under a shelf.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrench for turning nuts is a common hand tool.
